'''All Good Things''' is the 30th expansion of Star Trek CCG 1st Edition. It is published by Decipher on 16 July 2003. The set consists of 41 promo cards.

The longest-anticipated set in Star Trek CCG history. All those tantalizing references on earlier cards are finally realized in '''All Good Things''', a limited-edition set that mends all the "broken links" of First Edition (cards referenced from previous expansions but unreleased). However, this was not the case.

Each sturdy, 600 card '''All Good Things''' box contains 41 premium cards, one Starter Deck II reprint box of 62 cards, 10 booster packs from Reflections, one cello-wrapped ''U.S.S. Jupiter'' card from Armada, and a comprehensive First Edition collector's card list. There are 6 boxes per case.

==Additional Information==
*'''All Good Things''' was printed on 121 card sheets by Teagle & Little, USA.
*Each print sheet consisted of an 11 x 11 format.
*The print sheet had one copy of all 41 promo cards, 2 copies of the Rare Black Test card. and 78 Star Trek CCG 2nd Edition cards for a total of 121 cards (11x11).
